verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair question for a financial SaaS platform like Brex, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents APIs for managing accounting, expenses, budgets and users, plus an MCP server, but nothing about configurable retention periods, data deletion requests, or purge controls. Community threads about OpenAI data sharing raise privacy concerns but do not show any product capability for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
